label: Jobspresso
terms_note: Curated remote board; external apply or e-mail.

endpoints.call: the WP Job Manager RSS feeds (site feed + per-category /feed/) are usable public feeds
endpoints.notes: from the docs / live response read on 2026-09-05

reference.limits: Curated remote jobs. WordPress board (WP Job Manager + Indeed integration plugin); public RSS feeds, no developer API. robots.txt 4 rules; no terms page linked from the home page.

search.note: WP Job Manager job feed (?feed=job_feed, RSS 2.0). WP Job Manager's job_feed() reads search_keywords, search_location (';'-separated), job_types, job_categories and posts_per_page (default 10) and pages with paged (https://github.com/Automattic/WP-Job-Manager/blob/trunk/includes/class-wp-job-manager-post-types.php). company / location come from the job_listing:company / job_listing:location elements, description is the full post (content:encoded, HTML); job_type and job_category stay in raw. id is the posting's permalink. Jobspresso's /feed/ is an empty blog feed; ?feed=job_feed carries the remote jobs.

not_offered.me: No credentials to verify ('auth: none'): the feed is public and has no account endpoint.
not_offered.get_posting: The feed has no per-item endpoint (each posting's url is an HTML page); search returns the whole record in raw.
not_offered.apply: No application endpoint: the feed only lists postings; candidates apply on each posting's url (employer page / e-mail).
not_offered.list_messages: No messaging API; the only machine-readable interface is the public job feed.
